key_facts: The Army's Sources Sought notice for the Next Generation C-sUAS Missile (NGCM) has a deadline of August 20.
Initial specs call for intercepting drones at 6 km altitude and 16+ km range, with an ultimate goal of 8 km altitude and 25+ km range.
The missile must be compatible with the existing Coyote Launch System with minimal to no modifications.
The Army wants missiles costing less than $150,000 apiece as part of a bulk purchase of 5,000 missiles.
The Army is targeting Technology Readiness Level 7 by end of fiscal 2027, with 50 missiles ready for operational assessment by early 2028.
